interfaces.critical_singleton: The acquired critical singleton setting has n=2r>=14, every mark after rho0 fixes a, and G0 is the actual natural alternating group off a.
interfaces.growth: The complete acquired prefix proof gives strict C0<C1<C2 and fixation of a by all later marks; no pure alternating kernel or faithful orbit projection is inferred.
interfaces.support: At first shared g, the actual initial prefix has support at most 2g+1.
interfaces.small_permutations: Every even nonidentity involution on seven points is a double transposition. Normalizing rho0 and its commuting rho2 leaves eighteen explicit possibilities for rho1.
interfaces.preserved_orbits: The only proper-support growth cases either preserve a unique exterior pair or preserve an exterior triple distinguished from the equal-sized anchor orbit by fixation of a.
interfaces.actual_intersection: The remaining literal word is even and fixes a, hence belongs to actual G0. Full ambient IP identifies P1 intersect G0 with <rho1>, contradicting the word.

new_statements: An intransitive third prefix in the critical singleton setting moves at least eight points.
The first shared index g=3 cannot have an intransitive prefix.
contributions: The acquired singleton growth, support and actual natural omission remain paid. The exhaustive eighteen-case permutation proof is this continuation. A private exploration suggested the split but is not a proof premise.
